answers.core: NoiseTexture2D is often the basis for most shader effects. Meaning a lot of Godot game are/will be hit with this same issue. This seems like low hanging fruit that could significantly make shader heavy Godot games feel smoother.
answers.workaround:
It can be worked around by script but is far from ideal. This snippet tricks the NoiseTexture2D into using threads to generate the texture on init by suppling a 1x1 placeholder texture first and then resetting the size for the desired dimensions.

```gdscript
var noise = FastNoiseLite.new()
var noise_texture = NoiseTexture2D.new()
noise_texture.width = 1
noise_texture.height = 1
noise_texture.noise = noise
await get_tree().process_frame # or await noise_texture.changed
noise_texture.width = 1024
noise_texture.height = 1024 
```

title: Add a NoiseTexture2D property to generate it in the background (with a placeholder shown during generation)
